## Security and privacy

- [ ] No credential, token, `.env`, `.vscode/settings.json`, or personal absolute path is added.
- [ ] Project content still goes only to the provider the user selected.
- [ ] A new setting is application-scoped if it affects a credential, a spawned binary, a skill switch, or the permission default.
- [ ] Documentation and `docs/manual-test.md` counts are updated when behavior or test counts change.
